text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo say she want to go play.
That's why 
I decide to visit amusement park on my day
off.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah～!! So many! Lots of attraction! Trainer,
which one? 
Which one should we visit first?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo want to do everything so, 
uh uh… Let's start from there!!

As training progressed,
I had more things to 
think about. Maybe because of that,
I haven't 
been able to sleep well lately.

I was thinking to at least take it easy on
my day off, 
but when I look at Twin Turbo happy face 
I couldn't bring myself to say no.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Uwahaiiii!! Jet coaster is so fast! 
Nice fight with Turbo!! Uwaaaaaai!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Come out ghost!!
Turbo is not scared at all! 
Turbo is the scary one! Ugaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha!! The jet coaster is fast,
and the ghost 
was surprised when they see Turbo!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
The Coffee cup was spinning around make me
dizzy! 
Trainer almost jumped out of the cup was so
funny!
choice_data_list: We already visit most of the attra...

text_block_list.text:
It's almost the time. If the road is crowded,
we 
might barely pass the curfew.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehhh!? No no! I want to play～!
Want to play more～! 
Turbo is still full of energy!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Look Trainer! That way! 
There is boat over there,
and there is game corner next to it!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hey, let's go, let's go…

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
But…… ah! Then that one! 
That one will be the last!!

When I look at the direction where Twin
Turbo is 
pointing I can see the text "Giant Maze". 
It look like we are going to walk for a
while……

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo is a genius,
so I can reach the goal quickly!! 
Trainer just have to follow after Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

I couldn't resist the happy face of Twin
Turbo. 
As a result,
I ended up accompanying her through 
the giant maze with a sigh.

The sight of Twin Turbo that told me to
follow 
her disappear instantly…

I walked leisurely toward the goal,
I manage to 
reach the goal faster than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Another dead end!? Why!? Where am I!?
Trainer! 
Where is Trainer!? Did I get lost!?

As I was waiting on the bench,
I heard Twin Turbo's 
voice coming from inside the maze.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehhhhh!?!?! Why why!? 
Turbo was supposed to be in the front!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
What!? Another dead end! 
Unununu! Turbo engine reverse gear～!

The distant sound of twin turbo voices and
the 
rustling of the wind.
For some reason feel very 
comfortable. I closed my eyes and―

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm out!! As expected Turbo is genius!!
Ehehehe! 
Trainer, Trainer! Look I reach the goal―

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Eh? Trainer? 
Hey, hey!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
……Hah? Trainer, are you angry!? 
Is it because Turbo is late!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trai… ner? Ah you are sleeping!
You scared me! 
Wake up! Turbo reach the goal! Trainer!

I fell asleep while waiting. 
I haven't slept this well in a long time.

I shake my sleepy head and then exhale
deeply. 
My neck hurts a little from sleeping sitting
up, 
but I feel good.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I did!!
I made it without using the "ruthless" 
technique!!
I didn't give up because Turbo is 
amazing! That was fun!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
But, Trainer doesn't speak,
I thought you are angry 
because it was already pitch black
outside!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Eh?

While listening to Twin Turbo's frantic but
joyful voice in the distance.
The sound of the leaves 
and the breeze made for a very pleasant
time.

And just like now.
Listening to Twin Turbo who 
is happily talking about reaching the
goal, 
It always brightens my mood.

Ignoring her reaction,
I just say thank you at 
her directly.
Twin Turbo make a confused face, 
that look on her face make me laugh again.
choice_data_list: Now for sure, let's go home

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Eeh? …Ah, yeah.

While stretching,
we head toward the amusement park exit. 
I hope we can make it in time for curfew.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Even though I made you wait,
you are smiling…… 
……why??

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
You are always smiling… but, hmm? 
It's like… it's like… I don't know??
"thank you"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: ……Ah, yes!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Trainer!
Turbo is having so much fun! 
It's like boom-boom!

Is she happy because she get to play,
or is she 
happy as long as she is having fun.

Either way,
I was able to see Twin Turbo's 
happy face, so it doesn't matter.
